summary: View and Modify an Existing Purchase Order

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the Purchase Order application ("Display" or "Change" mode) from the SAP Fiori launchpad.
A specific Purchase Order can be retrieved by entering its PO number.
All PO details — including supplier, line items, materials, quantities, prices, delivery dates, and current status — are visible when the order is opened.
In display mode, no fields are editable and the order is strictly read-only.
A user with edit authorization can switch the order from display mode to edit mode.
In edit mode, relevant fields (such as order quantity) are modifiable.
Changes made to the Purchase Order are saved and persisted in the system upon confirmation.
A success message confirming the PO has been changed is displayed after a successful save.
The system displays a clear error message when an invalid or non-existent PO number is entered.
Fields that cannot be changed due to the order's processing status (e.g., already goods-receipted) are locked, with a relevant explanation shown to the user.

HP.description: Open an existing PO in Display mode and verify all header/item details are visible and read-only
Switch an open PO from Display to Edit mode, modify order quantity, save, and verify success message

NEG.description: Enter an invalid (non-existent) PO number — verify clear error message is displayed
Attempt to interact with an editable field while PO is in Display mode — verify field remains read-only
Attempt to switch to Edit mode without edit authorization — verify access is denied

ERR.description: Attempt to modify a goods-receipted (locked) item field in Edit mode — verify field is locked with explanation

EDGE.description: Modify quantity to minimum valid value (1) — verify save succeeds
Attempt to set quantity to zero — verify system rejection
Enter a PO number in invalid format (non-numeric or too short) — verify error message
